page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Configure connections and the AI assistant, and view app information.

about.tagline: A desktop SQL query, analysis, and scripting workspace.
about.notesUnavailable: Release notes aren’t available in this build.
about.ackIntro: The Tools tabs embed third-party apps. Credit belongs to their authors:

updates.available: Update available: v{{version}} (you are on v{{current}})
updates.noSource: No update source configured — automatic update checks are off.
updates.unsupported: Automatic self-update is only available in the packaged desktop app. To update a development checkout, stop the server, replace the files and start it again.

odbc.title: ODBC Connections
odbc.description: Save any ODBC data source as a reusable profile: pick a driver, fill in the settings and test the connection before you query. Switch databases from the picker in the Query tab.

builder.title: Visual Builder & SQL Editor
builder.description: Build a query without SQL — choose tables or views, then add filters, pick columns, set a date range and a row limit. Prefer raw SQL? Write it with dialect-aware formatting, or load a connection template to fill in the boilerplate.

charts.title: Charts & KPIs
charts.description: Turn the current result set into 20 chart types — bar, line, area, pie, scatter, histogram, box, waterfall, heatmap and more — or KPI cards. Pick X / Y / colour fields and tune operations, sorting and Top-N.

scripting.title: Python Scripting
scripting.description: Run a Python script against every row in the grid, with live stdout/stderr you can copy out. Five ready-made examples and saveable custom scripts cover the common analysis steps.

queries.title: Custom Queries & Run History
queries.description: Save Builder or SQL queries as reusable custom queries — with value prompts and Excel reports — and reopen any of the last 20 runs, complete with its connection, row count, timing and SQL.

tools.title: Tools & Integrations
tools.description: Three embedded workspaces open in place: FlowDiagram for AI-assisted architecture diagrams, Project for Gantt-style timelines and ProblemSolving for metric-bowler breakdowns.

ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.description: A docked assistant with SQL, script and chart modes: explain or optimise a query, draft a Python script, or describe a chart — then apply the answer straight into the editor, script or chart tab.

updates.title: Automatic Updates
updates.description: The app checks for a newer build in the background every hour and, when one is found, downloads, checksum-verifies, swaps and restarts itself on request. Settings → About keeps the release notes and full version history.

ack.flowdiagram: AI-assisted draw.io diagrams, courtesy of DayuanJiang’s GitHub repository.
ack.project: a Gantt-style timeline planner hosted at study-llm.me.
ack.problemsolving: a metric-bowler breakdown workspace hosted at study-llm.me.
